title: 暑假计划 · 英语岛基础阶段

schedule.planningAssumption: If development finishes on 2026-08-05, the earliest start is 2026-08-06 and 26 consecutive days fit through 2026-08-31.

policy.courseOrder: Short vowels → consonant digraphs → consonant blends → long vowels and silent e, with compact daily extensions for ck/qu/tch/ph, common vowel teams, r-controlled vowels, and oo/ou/ow/oi/oy.
policy.dailyStructure: phonics, contextual heart words, RAZ target words, spoken sentence frames, and every explicitly assigned review book
policy.audioRule: Existing verified Oxford clips remain valid; generated TTS is automatically playable without human review. Human recordings remain optional replacements and require explicit review. Do not scan Oxford tracks merely to source new course words.
policy.heartWordRule: New heart words are copied into an English notebook, then recalled by typing; reviews recur after expanding intervals.
policy.heartWordSelection: 100 foundational high-frequency words selected from Dolch early-reader words, retaining the course's RAZ anchor words; teaching follows UFLI guidance by decoding regular parts and marking only irregular parts for memory.

heartWords.instruction: 在英文句子中认出标注的心词；新词读 3 遍、写 3 遍，再遮住答案独立拼写；复习词必须拼写正确才能继续。
